account_links_valid_period_check.name: account_links_valid_period_check
account_links_valid_period_check.value: "account_links"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "account_links"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "account_links"."valid_until" > "account_links"."valid_from"

account_links_activation_evidence_check.name: account_links_activation_evidence_check
account_links_activation_evidence_check.value: "account_links"."status" <> 'active' OR ("account_links"."valid_from" IS NOT NULL AND "account_links"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

account_links_revocation_evidence_check.name: account_links_revocation_evidence_check
account_links_revocation_evidence_check.value: "account_links"."status" <> 'revoked' OR ("account_links"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_links"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "account_links"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)

account_sessions_revocation_evidence_che.name: account_sessions_revocation_evidence_check
account_sessions_revocation_evidence_che.value: "account_sessions"."status" <> 'revoked' OR ("account_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_sessions"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL)

accounts_disabled_evidence_check.name: accounts_disabled_evidence_check
accounts_disabled_evidence_check.value: "accounts"."status" = 'active' OR ("accounts"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."disabled_reason" IS NOT NULL)

affiliations_scope_check.name: affiliations_scope_check
affiliations_scope_check.value:
("affiliations"."scope_type" = 'tenant' AND "affiliations"."education_organization_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."school_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."class_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("affiliations"."scope_type" = 'education_organization' AND "affiliations"."education_organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "affiliations"."school_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."class_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("affiliations"."scope_type" = 'school' AND "affiliations"."education_organization_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."school_id" IS NOT NULL AND "affiliations"."class_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("affiliations"."scope_type" = 'class' AND "affiliations"."education_organization_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."school_id" IS NULL AND "affiliations"."class_id" IS NOT NULL)

affiliations_revocation_evidence_check.name: affiliations_revocation_evidence_check
affiliations_revocation_evidence_check.value: "affiliations"."status" <> 'revoked' OR ("affiliations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "affiliations"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "affiliations"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)

people_legacy_source_check.name: people_legacy_source_check
people_legacy_source_check.value:
("people"."source" <> 'legacy_user' OR "people"."legacy_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("people"."source" <> 'legacy_student' OR "people"."legacy_student_id" IS NOT NULL)

person_relationships_revocation_evidence.name: person_relationships_revocation_evidence_check
person_relationships_revocation_evidence.value: "person_relationships"."status" <> 'revoked' OR ("person_relationships"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "person_relationships"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "person_relationships"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)

role_template_assignments_revocation_evi.name: role_template_assignments_revocation_evidence_check
role_template_assignments_revocation_evi.value: "role_template_assignments"."status" <> 'revoked' OR ("role_template_assignments"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "role_template_assignments"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "role_template_assignments"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)
